title: Lightweight signal sampler and asks — Jan 2026
content:
Purpose:
Light (one-page) tracker to capture small cross-functional signals observed last 48–72h and proposed lightweight actions. Intended as a quick handoff list for rotation owners and product ops to surface items needing <2 days work or quick owner assignment.

Context/why:
- A lot of small low-friction items have been floating in Slack + tickets; we need a single mini-census to assign owners and avoid repeated pinging.
- Not a replacement for Jira/Confluence; this is triage-to-action for small items.

Table (columns): Priority | Signal | Suggested owner | Team | Action (1-line) | ETA | Status | Quick notes

Rows:
1) P0 | Embeddings billing spike (unexpected 15% month-to-date inc) | Omar Patel | finance + hosted-api | Run token-level sample to identify high-cost routes, enable short-term rate limit for /embed route for trial accounts | 2026-01-14 | in_progress | Sampling script ready, need billing export (PROD-4821)
2) P1 | eu-west-1 fallback coverage showing gaps during nightly GC window | Lina Park | platform-engineering | Add temporary region fallback route to eu-central and add alert for fallback-rate > 3% | 2026-01-16 | open | SRE observed ~2:00–3:30 UTC tail; ask infra for brief capacity bump
3) P2 | Console token-usage UI mismatch reported by customers | Ravi Menon | product-console | Quick triage: compare SDK vs console token calc for recent invoices, add note in UI if calc differs | 2026-01-18 | open | Customer reports on thread slack: #billing-cs, reproducible with sample customer id
4) P1 | Dedicated capacity forecast mismatch (reserved pool vs telemetry) | Maya Chen | product-dedicated | Short audit of reserved assignment logic; escalate if mismatch > 5% | 2026-01-20 | open | Might be double-counting burst allocation; see GH PR 1248 for related change
5) P3 | Small security review ask for on-prem packaging docs | Security rotation (assign) | security-and-compliance | Quick checklist + one-pager with KMS/HSM pointers for customer handoff | 2026-01-22 | open | Low effort; needed for sales call next week
6) P2 | Minor latency tail in small-model routing for short sequences | Platform SRE | observability | Add sampling hook for 99.9th percentile traces for requests <64 tokens | 2026-01-19 | in_progress | Related to batching policy edge-case during sustained low-load windows

Scratch estimates and constraints:
- Expected total time across items if assigned: ~28–36 engineer-hours (approx).
- Immediate work for P0/P1/P2 items should fit in day-of with 2 engineers each.

Quick checklist for owners (copy to ticket if creating):
- Confirm acceptance: owner + ack by EOD
- Create minimal ticket if work > 2 days OR escalate to on-call if production impact
- Add short note in this sheet: status updates + link to created ticket

Next steps / cadence:
- Weekly refresh on Mondays (10-minute async update).
- If item unresolved after 7 days, escalate to product-ops review and decide follow-up (close / backlog / escalate).

Unresolved questions / open asks:
- Omar: need billing export access for last 90 days (who to ping in finance?)
- Lina: confirm whether eu-west-1 GC window aligns with our scheduled maintenance windows
- Ravi: provide example invoice where tokens mismatch appears (customer id sanitized)

Notes to self (Maya):
- Use this template for quick collection during on-call rotation handoffs.
- Add automated copy to /ops daily digest if this sheet contains >3 open P0/P1 items.

Linked quick references:
- Billing analysis query (Saved BigQuery): bq://prod.billing.embeddings_costs
- Runtime PR re: burst accounting: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1248
- Slack thread with initial ping: slack://channel/platform-ops/thread/GB12345

Log of changes (brief):
- 2026-01-12: initial capture (Maya)
- 2026-01-13: added P0 billing row (Omar)
- 2026-01-14: updated status for embeddings sampling -> in_progress (Omar)
